notes: PortfolioResponse and PortfolioResponseWithPnl both wrap a single clientPortfolio object — the WithPnl variant is for endpoints that include PnL calculations
ClientPortfolio depends on Position, Mirror, Order, OrderForOpen, OrderForClose, OrderForCloseMultiple — all in trading-schema.json
getUserDailyGainResponse uses oneOf — it is EITHER a Vec<gainEntry> OR an object {gain: number}. Use #[serde(untagged)] enum in Rust
GeCopiersResponse name appears to be a typo in the spec (likely meant 'GetCopiersResponse')

PortfolioResponse inlines the entire shape (positions/orders/mirrors objects), while PortfolioResponseWithPnl uses $refs to ClientPortfolio + Position + Mirror + Order schemas — same data, different definition style

PortfolioResponse.clientPortfolio.orders fields use 'orderID', 'instrumentID', 'CID' (capital ID) but ClientPortfolio.orders refs the standalone Order schema which uses 'orderId' / 'instrumentId' (lowercase) — pick one shape based on which endpoint you call
